title: SimpleLogin - Alerts
description: One panel per alert rule. Each panel graphs the expression its alert evaluates and shades the alerting range. Generated by monitor/grafana/generate_alerts.py.

panels.title: SimpleLogin alerts (firing, pending, no data, error)
Scrape target up (per host)
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin host not scraped when < 1 for 3m. Prometheus cannot scrape {{ $labels.instance }}: the host or its exporter is down.

panels.title: Email handler processes vs 1h max (per host)
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin email handler processes lost when < 0.8 for 5m. {{ $labels.instance }} runs less than 80% of the email handler processes it had in the last hour.

targets.expr: (count by (instance) (process_start_time_seconds{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}) or count by (instance) (process_start_time_seconds{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"} offset 15m) * 0) / max_over_time((count by (instance) (process_start_time_seconds{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}))[1h:1m])

panels.title: Container restarts in 15m (max per container group)
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin container crash looping when > 3 for 5m. A {{ $labels.group }} container on {{ $labels.instance }} restarted more than 3 times in 15 minutes.

panels.title: Web app (sl-app) 5xx ratio
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin web app 5xx errors when > 0.05 for 5m. More than 5% of sl-app responses are 5xx (only counted when there are more than 5 errors in 5 minutes).

targets.expr: sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-app.*", code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-app.*"}[5m])) and on() sum(increase(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-app.*", code=~"5.."}[5m])) > 5

panels.title: Partner API (sl-partner-api) 5xx ratio
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin partner API 5xx errors when > 0.02 for 5m. More than 2% of sl-partner-api responses are 5xx (only counted when there are more than 5 errors in 5 minutes).

targets.expr: sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-partner-api.*", code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-partner-api.*"}[5m])) and on() sum(increase(simplelogin_custom_event_httpresponsestatus_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-partner-api.*", code=~"5.."}[5m])) > 5

panels.title: Web app (sl-app) requests /s
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin web app receives no traffic when < 0.05 for 10m. sl-app served almost no requests for 10 minutes: it is down or unreachable.

panels.title: Partner API (sl-partner-api) requests /s
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin partner API receives no traffic when < 0.1 for 10m. sl-partner-api served almost no requests for 10 minutes: it is down or unreachable.

panels.title: Incoming emails /s (total)
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin incoming email volume collapsed when < 5 for 10m. Fewer than 5 emails/s are handled across all hosts: inbound mail is not reaching the email handlers.

panels.title: Incoming emails /s per host
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin host not receiving email when < 0.1 for 10m. {{ $labels.instance }} handled almost no incoming email for 10 minutes while the other hosts keep receiving.

panels.title: Average email handler time
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin email handling is slow when > 5 for 10m. Handling an incoming email takes more than 5s on average (normally under 1s).

targets.expr: sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_email_handler_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_email_handler_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-email.*"}[5m]))

panels.title: SMTP error ratio per host (errors / send attempts)
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin SMTP send errors when > 0.1 for 10m. More than 10% of SMTP sends from {{ $labels.instance }} fail (disconnects, timeouts, refused connections).

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_event_smtperror_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_sending_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: Average SMTP servers tried per send
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin SMTP failing over to backup servers when > 1.3 for 10m. {{ $labels.instance }} needs more than 1.3 SMTP servers per send on average: the primary relay is failing.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_servers_tried_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_servers_tried_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: Average SMTP connection time per host
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin SMTP connections are slow when > 1 for 10m. Opening an SMTP connection from {{ $labels.instance }} takes more than 1s on average (normally about 0.1s).

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_connection_time_sum{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_custom_smtp_connection_time_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.title: PGP encryption failure ratio
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin PGP encryption failures when > 0.1 for 15m. More than 10% of PGP encryptions fail (normally about 1%).

panels.title: Partner events processed / stored
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin partner events not processed when < 0.5 for 15m. Less than half of the partner events stored in the DB are being sent: the event listener is stuck.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_sync_event_processed_count{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[15m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(simplelogin_custom_event_eventstoredtodb_total{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance"}[15m]))

panels.title: Partner event end-to-end lag (avg)
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin partner event sync lagging when > 120 for 10m. Partner events take more than 2 minutes on average to be delivered (normally a few seconds).

panels.title: Sync events failed /min
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin partner sync events failing when > 1 for 10m. More than 1 partner sync event per minute fails.

panels.title: Partner webhook non-2xx /min
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin partner webhook errors when > 1 for 10m. The partner rejects more than 1 event per minute (non-2xx responses).

panels.title: Jobs in error /min
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin jobs failing when > 10 for 15m. More than 10 jobs per minute end in error (normally under 2).

panels.title: Jobs picked /min
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin job runner stalled when < 1 for 30m. The job runner picked fewer than 1 job per minute for 30 minutes (normally about 60).

panels.title: Clients waiting for a DB connection
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin clients waiting for DB connections when > 5 for 2m. More than 5 clients on {{ $labels.instance }} are queued for a database connection: the pool is exhausted.

panels.title: DB server errors + checkout timeouts /min
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin DB pool errors when > 1 for 5m. pgdog on {{ $labels.instance }} reports server errors or checkout timeouts.

targets.expr: 60 * (sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_pgdog_total_server_errors{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog"}[5m])) + sum by (instance) (rate(simplelogin_pgdog_total_checkout_timeouts{job="simplelogin-upcloud", env="$env", instance=~"$instance", container=~"sl-pgdog"}[5m])))

panels.title: Banned DB servers
panels.description: CRITICAL: SimpleLogin DB server banned by pgdog when > 0 for 2m. pgdog on {{ $labels.instance }} banned a database server after repeated failures.

panels.title: Disk used %
panels.description:
WARNING: SimpleLogin disk space low when > 85 for 10m. {{ $labels.path }} on {{ $labels.instance }} is more than 85% full.
CRITICAL: SimpleLogin disk almost full when > 95 for 5m. {{ $labels.path }} on {{ $labels.instance }} is more than 95% full.

panels.title: Disk free predicted in 24h (from last 6h trend)
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin disk will fill within 24h when < 0 for 30m. At the current rate {{ $labels.path }} on {{ $labels.instance }} runs out of space within 24 hours.

panels.title: Memory used %
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin host memory high when > 90 for 10m. {{ $labels.instance }} uses more than 90% of its memory (normally under 50%).

panels.title: CPU used %
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin host CPU saturated when > 95 for 15m. {{ $labels.instance }} CPU is above 95% for 15 minutes.

panels.title: CPU iowait %
panels.description: WARNING: SimpleLogin host disk I/O saturated when > 20 for 10m. {{ $labels.instance }} spends more than 20% of CPU time waiting on disk I/O.
